Phone is official: qaweem.sa says 'فرع الرياض مركز قويم - الرياض - حيّ الملز جوّال: 0569088001 الرقم الموحّد: 920025923'. Hours are secondary: Google Maps listing 'مركز قويم لعلاج الإدمان بالرياض', Al Malaz, Riyadh 12836 shows Sunday-Thursday 10 AM-7 PM, Friday and Saturday Closed. The listing shows a different mobile (054 176 5370) that is not on the centre's own site; the own-site numbers were kept. Confidence medium applies to the hours only.

Move confirmed by ajel.sa (16 Feb 2026, quoting Riyadh Third Health Cluster): moved from Al Khuzama 'إلى مقره الجديد في مخرج 18 على طريق النهضة', operating since 13 Feb; 'تعمل الطوارئ على مدار الساعة', other services 'من الأحد إلى الخميس من الساعة الثامنة صباحًا حتى الرابعة مساءً' (Su-Th 08:00-16:00). Google Maps listing 'Erada Complex for Mental Health in Riyadh', Al Nahda Rd, Al Faisaliyyah, Riyadh 12883: 24.631454, 46.782422, phone +966 800 124 0444, 'Open 24 hours'. A second listing 'مجمع ارادة والصحة النفسية بالرياض ( المقر الجديد)' sits about 300 m away at 24.633099, 46.785190 (3116 An Nahdah branch road, Al Faisaliyyah). The old landline +966114804548 appears only in the 2023 MoH guide for the old site and was not confirmed for the new site by any source. No official page gives coordinates or a phone; not in OpenStreetMap (Nominatim and Photon returned nothing).

Nothing states the addiction clinic's own hours or a clinic phone, so hours stay null and the hospital number +966114311100 was not re-confirmed.
